title: Module functions
description: The service a module performs, whether Forge builds it or an integration module connects a product that does it. A module spec's module_identity.function is one of these (owner, 2026-11-19, FB-153). Adding a function is one approved change to this list.

entries.description: Manufacturing execution: orders, batches, recipes, changeover.
Maintenance management: equipment, work orders, maintenance events.
Enterprise resource planning: master data, orders, finance.
Network management: the plant network's topology and health.
Process history: one time-series store, trends, export.
The plant floor: process controllers, tags, alarms, control writes.
User interfaces: every screen, and the designer.
The MPC Supervisor of the process control framework (PC-L2).
